summary: Focused claim o-997c30f9b4aabc09 (g0003): the old harness checks the XInclude context error after processing, but the supplied evidence cannot establish whether an injected allocation failure makes that check fail on either source version.
missing_information: The effect of error.c::xmlRaiseMemoryError on the XInclude context's errNo field is not supplied.
The installed allocator callbacks and URL propagation needed to establish a feasible input-controlled failure at the shown processing site are not supplied.
requested_symbols: the allocator callbacks installed by xmlFuzzMemSetup

assessment.necessity_reason: The before reporter assigns XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to the context; the after reporter delegates error reporting. A feasible injected failure and the delegate's effect on the context error are unresolved.

before.requirement: When an injected allocation failure is reported during XInclude processing, xmlXIncludeGetLastError must return XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY for the existing harness check.
before.reason: The reporter directly assigns the expected error code, but the supplied allocator and document URL path do not establish a feasible input that reaches the shown failure site.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The getter returns the context errNo field checked by the harness.
A failed base URL allocation calls the memory-error reporter and returns before further processing.

after.requirement: For the same reported allocation failure, xmlXIncludeGetLastError must return XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY for the existing harness check.
after.reason: The changed reporter calls xmlRaiseMemoryError without directly assigning errNo. Its effect on that field is not supplied, and feasibility of the injected failure remains unresolved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The getter still returns the context errNo field.
The corresponding base URL allocation failure calls the changed reporter and returns.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The existing check aborts when the recorded allocation failure differs from the expected context error state.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same old check applies on both sides. The direct errNo assignment disappears after the change, but the supplied evidence establishes neither a feasible input-controlled failure nor the delegated reporter's final effect on errNo.
missing_information: Complete error.c::xmlRaiseMemoryError on the after side, including its effect when the supplied handler and handler context are NULL.
Complete fuzz/fuzz.c::xmlFuzzMemSetup and its installed allocator callbacks, to establish how the input-derived limit triggers allocation failure.
Complete parser.c::xmlDoRead on both sides, to establish whether the harness-supplied URL reaches tree->doc->URL at the shown failure site.
